comment: We should evaluate both. Not sure which makes sense to do first. There should be a disadvantage for growing a big blob of roots that fully fills in all space. If the root cell isnt touching soil it cannot benefit the plant and has a cost or maybe it or maybe there are costs and benefits but it only grows bloby in certain environments but in most it doesn't.
